steps.title: Decontaminate skin samples
steps.instruction: Individually vortex each skin sample in 10 % commercial sodium hypochlorite solution, then vortex in 70 % ethanol to remove bleach.

steps.title: Add digestion buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add each skin sample to 1 mL digestion buffer containing 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0), 10 mM NaCl, 2 % w/v SDS, 5 mM CaCl₂, 2.5 mM EDTA (pH 8.0), 40 mM DTT, and 10 % Proteinase K; incubate for 12 hours at 56 °C.

steps.title: Phenol extraction
steps.instruction: Mix 1 mL supernatant with 1 mL phenol, vortex for 20 seconds, gently rotate for 5 minutes, then centrifuge at 3000 g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Remove approximately 1 mL aqueous phase, mix with 1 mL chloroform, vortex for 30 seconds, and centrifuge at 3000 g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Purify DNA with MinElute kit
steps.instruction: Remove approximately 1 mL aqueous phase and purify using the Qiagen MinElute PCR Purification kit with two modifications: (1) adjust the PB buffer as described by Allentoft et al. 2015, and (2) increase the PB binding‑buffer volume to 10 ×. Apply the modified buffer to the spin columns using a Zymo‑Spin V reservoir following the Dabney et al. 2013 method.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL EB buffer to the column, incubate for 15 minutes at 37 °C, then centrifuge at 6000 g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Quantify extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Qubit fluorometer using the dsDNA High‑Sensitivity assay (Life Technologies, Carlsbad, CA).
